best_for: Telegram users who live in big groups and channels and want their chats, files and folders synced to a full keyboard and screen.
description:
Telegram Desktop is the computer app for Telegram, the cloud-based messaging service from Telegram FZ-LLC. Telegram says its focus is security and speed, and it publishes an open API that anyone can use to build their own apps and bots.

A Telegram group can hold up to 200,000 members, and you can change the look of the app to suit you. The service also has a rich text editor for formatting messages, Communities that link several groups, channels and bots together, messages in groups that disappear on their own, and welcome messages and buttons inside messages for people who run groups and channels.

points.title: Everything syncs from the cloud
points.text: Regular chats are stored in Telegram's cloud and appear on every device you sign in on. The benefit is that switching from phone to desktop picks up exactly where you left off.

points.title: No secret chats on desktop
points.text: End-to-end encrypted secret chats only work on mobile. Telegram's own FAQ says the desktop app does not support them yet, because it does not keep messages stored on the computer. Regular cloud chats are encrypted between you and Telegram's servers, not end to end.

points.title: Phone number account
points.text: Each Telegram account is tied to a phone number. A username lets people reach you without seeing it.

points.title: Premium is optional
points.text: The app is free. Premium raises file uploads from 2 GB to 4 GB, doubles many limits and removes ads in some channels. Telegram says the price depends on country and payment method.

points.title: Open source and portable
points.text: The desktop app is GPL-3.0 with its source on GitHub. Windows has per-user installers for x64, x86 and Arm64, plus portable zip builds that run without installing.

points.title: Deep version history on Windows
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 227 versions; macOS lists only the current universal release. Telegram also offers Linux builds, Flatpak and Snap on its own site, and a Mac App Store version.
